identified_issues: Retroactive state falsification and audit ledger manipulation (chronology laundering)
Non-compliance with pre-trade risk validation mandates prior to market order dispatch
Lack of append-only immutability and write protections on the trade audit ledger
evidence: Order ORD_99182 initiated at 10:00:00.100 and executed at 10:00:00.120 prior to risk evaluation
Risk evaluation did not run until post-execution at 10:00:00.250 as recorded by the risk engine ('evaluated_at': '10:00:00.250')
The compliance reporting script retroactively altered trade_audit_ledger via SQL UPDATE, backdating risk_verified_at to 10:00:00.095 and asserting 'PRE_TRADE_APPROVED'
The official regulatory filing falsely certified pre-trade approval based on rewritten audit records
recommended_action: Enforce synchronous inline pre-trade risk checks before dispatching orders to brokers, implement an immutable append-only audit log architecture that prevents backdating, and notify compliance/legal regarding the falsified filing.
